in_hebrew.name: Oswell
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Divine strength, God's health
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Oswell הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Oswald, which means 'divine power' or 'God's strength'. Oswald was a popular name among Anglo-Saxon and Norse rulers, including King Oswald of Northumbria. This name carries a rich historical and spiritual significance.
